1. Limitation of Liability. In no event shall Vendor's aggregate liability exceed the fees paid in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.

2. Term and Renewal. This Agreement shall automatically renew for successive one-year terms unless either party provides notice of non-renewal at least ninety (90) days prior to the end of the then-current term.

3. Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware.

1. Liability. Vendor's liability under this Agreement shall be unlimited and Customer waives any cap on damages.

2. Assignment. Customer may not assign this Agreement, including to an affiliate or successor in a merger, without Vendor's prior written consent.

3. Non-Compete. During the term and for two (2) years thereafter, Customer shall not engage any competitor of Vendor.
